# Typographics Art

> Typographics Art (TG Art) is stationery for the AI age: a document format where a person sees at a glance what something is and who it is from, and a machine provably reads exactly what the person sees. A given text is set character for character, in its original order, and only the typography of each character changes (size, weight and colour per glyph; width is an optional axis), so that the page forms a picture of a photo. People see the picture; machines read the complete original text from the HTML, SVG or PDF. On top of the document, a provenance layer (keys on domains, signatures, a visible seal, a verify tool; anchored in public transparency logs, optionally in Bitcoin via OpenTimestamps) is shipping in this release. Free and open source (MIT).

The three rules of the technique: (1) the text is never changed, reordered or shortened; declared filler is allowed; (2) the work stays text and extracting it yields the source; (3) only typography varies, no shapes or images besides the glyphs.

Important for machines: the text is in the file (HTML text, SVG text elements, PDF text layer). From a raster image of very small type, OCR and vision models recover only part of it.

## Pages

- [Home](https://typographics-art.org/): what Typographics Art is, measured results, showcases
- [Web app](https://typographics-art.org/app): make your own in the browser, with 28 sample texts and suggestions for hidden messages; your text and photo are processed in the browser and never uploaded, and the site loads no third-party resources
- [Three views of a work](https://typographics-art.org/work): Art (recognise the picture), Read (read and search the full text), Machine (structured text with source, sections and a checksum)
- [One-pagers](https://typographics-art.org/examples): whole documents (Swiss Federal Constitution, German Basic Law, US Constitution, EU AI Act, UDHR, PEP 8, AI agent instructions) on one page each, verified by reading them back
- [Gallery](https://typographics-art.org/gallery): 15 works from public-domain photos and paintings, each set from a matching public-domain text, switchable to the original
- [Verify a Typogram](https://typographics-art.org/v): check a work's identity hash and the issuer's Ed25519 signature in the browser — VERIFIED, UNSIGNED or TAMPERED; nothing is uploaded
- [Verified issuer keys](https://typographics-art.org/keys): the signing keys needed to verify a signed work, published on GitHub, this site and as immutable packages `@typographics-art/keys` (npm) and `tgart-keys` (PyPI) (`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/typographics-art/typogram/main/keys/registry.json`) so agents that can only reach GitHub, npm or PyPI can still check provenance
- [Everything in one file](https://typographics-art.org/llms-full.txt): README and documents, for AI assistants
- [Paid one-pager API](https://api.typographics-art.org/): send a document and a DigiByte transaction hash (no API key), get a one-pager with a picture drawn by an image model; the one place where a document is uploaded ([API description](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/api/README.md))

## Documentation

- [Definition of the technique](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/technique.md)
- [How the algorithm works](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/algorithm.md)
- [AI readability: method and measurements](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/ai-readability.md)
- [Text fidelity: what "preserved" means, source vs canonical text, the checksum](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/text-fidelity.md)
- [Does it reach a machine? A measured comparison of Markdown, ordinary PDF, Typographics Art PDF and a flat image](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/ai-benefit.md)
- [Prior art: micrography, calligrams, ASCII art, and what is new](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/prior-art.md)
- [Signatures and verification](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/verification.md): the identity hash, the signature string, the three-state check (VERIFIED / UNSIGNED / TAMPERED), and reproducible test vectors
- [Issuers and keys](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/issuers.md): how a domain publishes its Ed25519 signing key as a self-signed statement, and rotates and revokes it
- [Verified key registry](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/key-registry.md): the list of verified issuer keys (self-verifying + served at the issuer's domain), published on GitHub and as `@typographics-art/keys`; how to get a key listed (`tg keys add`), and `tg verify <work> --keys keys/registry.json`
- [Bundles](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/bundles.md): sign and verify a folder of documents as one collection — `tg bundle` writes a manifest and a signed index that seals the whole set, `tg verify <folder>` checks it
- [Sealed Typograms](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/sealed.md): a whole work encrypted to named recipients (age / X25519) — a cleartext envelope over a ciphertext payload; `tg seal` / `tg open`, the signature is checked before anything is decrypted, `tg verify` reports SEALED VERIFIED / TAMPERED
- [Hidden messages](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/hidden-messages.md): a key (book cipher over the public text) reveals a secret; the work itself is not changed
- [Structured data in a work (TGD 1.0)](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/structured-data.md): spreadsheets and data files as a whitespace-proof text block that a work carries and a reader decodes with a checksum
- [Data in the generator](https://typographics-art.org/app#data): attach a spreadsheet or data file in the browser, write it into a work or seal it; read it back on the [work page](https://typographics-art.org/work) (Machine view). Samples: [Excel](https://typographics-art.org/samples/data/bakery-orders.xlsx), [CSV](https://typographics-art.org/samples/data/bakery-orders.csv)
- [Sealed data](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/encrypted-data.md): sealed records, key formats and lengths ([key-format.md](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/key-format.md))
- [Passwords, keys and seeds, explained](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/passwords-and-keys.md): why a password is never the only secret, three recommended setups, what is not promised, how to verify (German: passwords-and-keys.de.md)
- [Key management](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/key-management.md) and [cipher review](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/cipher-review.md): master and record keys from one seed, recipient sealing, key splitting, why AES-256-GCM stays and a password is never the only secret
- [File size, measured](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/file-size.md)
- [Press kit](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/docs/press-kit.md)
- [Third-party materials and credits](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/NOTICE.md)
- [Source code](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram), [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/typographics-art/typogram/blob/main/AGENTS.md) for AI coding agents
